name: AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro
blurb: AssemblyAI’s current flagship — contextual prompting, native code-switching, and diarisation for real conversations.
about: Universal-3.5 Pro (July 2026) is AssemblyAI’s current pre-recorded flagship. It adds native mid-sentence code-switching across 18 languages, contextual prompting, and the company’s most accurate speaker diarisation. It records 5.03% average cleaned WER in the current Open ASR Leaderboard evaluation.

Universal-3.5 Pro Realtime carries conversation context between turns and accepts agent context for live voice applications. Pre-recorded usage is $0.21/hr and Realtime is $0.45/hr; Universal-2 remains the 99-language fallback. Cloud-only — prices change, so check the pricing page.
install:
pip install assemblyai
# export ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY=...

python -c "
import assemblyai as aai
t = aai.Transcriber().transcribe('audio.mp3')
print(t.text)"
